ENPTES
R-02 · Fields 01 of 06

A dense geometric field of repeating blocks constructs an unstable spatial system. Light and shadow shift across its surface, producing fluctuating depth without fixed orientation. The structure resists resolution, sustaining tension through pattern, compression and ambiguity.
